title: WinB-to-Central native relay send returned 503 "native mailbox relay response unavailable" (outcome unknown) on the running Central build
outcome: WinB-to-Central native relay send returned 503 "native mailbox relay response unavailable" (outcome unknown) on the running Central build
acceptance: After Central runs a build that includes 11d1d110 (w-32ed: a definite relay writer-admission refusal instead of UNKNOWN), WinB-to-Central native relay sends are observed: either no 'response unavailable / outcome may be unknown' 503 recurs over the observation, or each recurrence's cause is identified from source and logs (home writer admission, link change, timeout or other).

If a cause other than writer admission remains, it is fixed so the sender gets a definite outcome, or the documented unknown outcome is shown to be unavoidable for that cause. A behavioural test covers the fixed path.
